title: Idea room
last_seen_content:
Flyout Probe

A night courier in Mumbai discovers her delivery bag swaps whatever is inside with an object from the recipient's greatest regret.
She keeps one swapped item: a brass key nobody has claimed.

messages.content: You keep circling back to brass key — good instinct. So make it cost something. What does it take from someone before the story ends? Who benefits from it staying exactly as you wrote it?

I've read the page — I'm not going to read it back to you. The bit I keep snagging on is a brass key nobody has claimed..

Tell me the version where a brass key nobody has claimed. goes wrong. What breaks? I think the idea's real test lives one step past that.
